info.title: PER Middleware API
info.description: Request a fresh TDX remote-attestation quote binding a caller-supplied challenge, for on-demand verification that the validator is running inside a genuine Intel TDX enclave.

get.description: Generates a new TDX quote with `challenge` bound into the report data, by making a fresh call into the TDX guest device. This is slower than `/fast-quote` since it performs the attestation ioctl on every call, but it does not depend on any previously-cached key material. Fails with an internal error if the service is not running on genuine TDX guest hardware.

parameters.name: challenge
parameters.description: Base64-encoded, exactly 64 bytes, bound into the quote's report data.

quote.description: Base64-encoded TDX quote, verifiable against Intel's DCAP verification service.

500.description: Internal server error, e.g. no TDX guest device present, or `challenge` does not decode to exactly 64 bytes
